# Electron embedding change is a mitigation

The imported Task 3 summary reports an Electron embedding worker using local `onnxruntime-web` WASM with one thread, local model bytes, and disabled WASM cache. It reports seven focused tests and a smoke result of 32 finite 384-dimensional vectors. These results support the embedding path only. The native ONNX diagnostic stack did not prove the cause of whole-application termination, so treat the change as a crash mitigation until real restart and use confirm it. Current source and runtime behavior need verification.

Scope: console knowledge embeddings.
